authorization_scope: Prepare a reviewable future model design only. This does not authorize observations, mappings, returns, model fitting or statistical tests.

primary_analysis.measure: Original market-adjusted post-entry measure from aligned open-to-open total-economic increments; exact economics and entry/calendar authority remain Phase-3 requirements.

secondary_regression_candidate.outcome: Only the subsequently authorized registered 21-session outcome; currently unavailable and not calculated.
secondary_regression_candidate.predictor: 1 for source-validated AUTHORIZATION_INCREASE; 0 for source-validated NEW_AUTHORIZATION. Unresolved, ASR-only and non-target records cannot be coerced into either category.
secondary_regression_candidate.estimand: Exploratory conditional association among the eventually eligible sampled events; no causal or validated-alpha claim.
secondary_regression_candidate.capacity_caution: Do not pool dollar, share-count and percentage authorizations into a single unvalidated size feature; currencies and historical baselines remain separate.

pre_execution_requirements: Applicable full-source factual QA and adjudication
Accession-specific registered public-time evidence and classification availability
Explicit Phase-3 authorization, licensed historical security/economics authority, calendar and permissions
Prospective final formula, estimand, dependence/overlap inference, multiplicity allocation and inclusion/missingness rules
Explicit outcome-analysis authorization before obtaining or fitting the response

inference.issuer_repetition_and_date_clustering: Audit on an accepted event roster before outcomes; no naive independence assumption is registered.

method_reference.title: Event Study Testing with Cross-sectional Correlation of Abnormal Returns

inference.reference_scope: Motivates resolving cross-sectional dependence; no test or standard-error method is selected or run here.

multiplicity.secondary_regression_allocation: UNRESOLVED; no additional automatic testing budget

sample_limitations: Targeted 100-source development feasibility sample, not an exhaustive event census
Five current-release candidates have source-supported scope but zero are certified for economic analysis
